subject: Film & Cinema
title: Script Doctors and Ghost Writers
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Script Doctors and Ghost Writers.

hook.text: Some of Hollywood's best dialogue was written by people whose names never appear on screen.

buildup.text: Script doctors are hired to fix specific problems — dialogue, structure, or a weak third act.

discovery.text: Carrie Fisher was a legendary uncredited script doctor who polished major blockbusters.

twist.text: WGA rules mean script doctors often receive no credit despite major contributions.

climax.text: The invisible labor behind films challenges our ideas about individual authorship.

punchline.text: The best fixes come from names you'll never know.

quiz.question: What does a script doctor do?
options: Fixes specific problems in an existing script
